title.narrative: Investing for Impact in the Gabonese Republic - Gabon (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Gabon, Multicomponent, Ministry of Health of the Gabonese Republic (MoH)This program has the following goals: Réduire les nouvelles infections du VIH de 95% d'ici 2027 / Reduce new HIV infections by 95% by 2027. Réduire le taux de transmission du VIH de la mère à l'enfant de 13% à 7% d'ici 2027 / Reduce the rate of mother-to-child transmission of HIV from 13% to 7% by 2027. Réduire le nombre des décès liés au VIH de 95% d'ici 2027 / Reduce HIV-related deaths by 95% by 2027. Assurer la protection sociale, le soutien, le respect des droits humains, du genre et de l'équité dans la réponse nationale au VIH / Ensure social protection, support, respect for human rights, gender and equity in the national response to HIV. D’ici 2027, contribuer à une réduction 7% de l’incidence liée à la tuberculose au Gabon c'est-à-dire passer d’une incidence de 509 cas en 2022 à 480 cas pour 100 000 habitants / By 2027, contribute to a 7% reduction in the incidence of tuberculosis in Gabon, i.e. go from an incidence of 509 cases in 2022 to 480 cases per 100,000 inhabitants. D’ici 2027, contribuer à la réduction de la mortalité de 80 décès pour 100 000 habitants en 2022 à 71 décès/100,000 habitants dues à la tuberculose. / By 2027, contribute to the reduction of mortality from 80 deaths per 100,000 inhabitants in 2022 to 71 deaths/100,000 inhabitants due to tuberculosis.. D’ici 2027, réduire d’au moins 65%, l’incidence et la mortalité liées au paludisme par rapport à 2021 / By 2027, reduce at least 65% of malaria incidence and mortality compared to 2021. The objectives of this program are: Reduire les nouvelles infections au VIH de 1900 en 2022 à 816 en 2027 / Reduce new HIV infections from 1900 in 2022 to 816 in 2027. Reduire la mortalité liée au VIH de 1800 décès en 2022 à 800 en 2027 /Reduce HIV-related mortality from 1,800 deaths in 2022 to 800 in 2027. Augmenter la notification des cas de tuberculose nouveaux cas et rechutes de tuberculose de 6575 en 2023 à 10157 en 2027 et avoir un succés thérapeutique pour 86% des cas mis sous traitement / Increase the notification of new cases and relapses of tuberculosis from 6,575 in 2023 to 9,399 in 2027 and have therapeutic success for 86% of cases put under treatment.. Augmenter de 90 cas de TB-RR et ou TB-MR en 2022 à 222 cas en 2027 la notification des patients annuellement mis sous traitement pour une tuberculose multi-résistante ou résistante à la rifampicine et atteindre un taux de succès thérapeutique d'au moins 63% en 2027. / Increase from 90 cases of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB in 2022 to 222 cases in 2027 the notification of patients annually placed on treatment for multi-drug-resistant or rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis and achieve a therapeutic success rate of at least 63% in 2027.. Effectuer en 2027 le depistage VIH chez 92% des nouveaux cas et rechutes et mettre sous therapie préventive au moins 10% des personnes vivant avec le VIH éligible. / Carry out HIV screening in 92% of new cases and relapses in 2027 and put at least 10% of eligible people living with HIV on preventive therapy.. Augmenter le pourcentage des patients atteints de TB enregistrés nouveaux cas et rechutes dont le statut sérologique VIH est documenté, de 53% en 2023 à 92% en 2027 / Increase the percentage of TB patients registered new cases and relapses whose HIV serological status is documented, from 53% in 2023 to 92% in 2027.

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for GAB-Z-MOHP01
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
